title: Check pool demand against the connection allocation
method: Synthetic limit 180−20 reserved=160 application connections. Eight replicas×25=200 demand, exceeding allocation by 40. At pool 20, eight replicas use 160; twelve permit 240. Not a tuning recommendation.
alt: Check pool demand against the connection allocation: Database limit 180 connections, Application allocation 160 connections, Original pool demand 200 connections. Synthetic example.
